description: Explain WHAT DRIVES the returns of a ticker, ETF or built-in portfolio by decomposing them into common factor exposures (market, size, value, momentum, quality, low-volatility, duration, credit) plus an idiosyncratic residual. Use this when the user asks why two assets move together, what a fund is really exposed to, whether a stock is a growth or value tilt, how much of a return is just market beta, whether it has real alpha, or what is driving a portfolio's returns. Returns betas (loadings), t-stats, an additive variance decomposition (shares sum to R²), annualized alpha, idiosyncratic vs total volatility, and for a portfolio the holdings that drive each factor. Computed by OLS regression on real price history via tradeable ETF proxies (long-short factor spreads): measured exposure, not a forecast. Provide exactly one of `target` (a ticker, computed live), `template` (a built-in model portfolio), `strategy` (a canonical strategy) or `assets` (your own allocation, including nested portfolios, rotations and strategies as holdings, computed live); portfolio ids are answered from precomputed monthly data through the stated month. Portfolios (ids and `assets`) use the five default factors (market, size, value, duration, credit), are monthly and ignore `frequency` and `factors`. For performance numbers use analyze_portfolio. Read-only.

assets.description: Your own allocation instead of an id, computed live (monthly, default factors; the answer also lists the holdings behind each factor). Same format as analyze_portfolio: plain tickers and nested portfolios, rotations or strategies via `sleeve`. Weights in percent, summing to ~100.

sleeve.description: Advanced: a strategy node instead of a plain ticker — the app's SleeveRef, resolved server-side. Supported: a rotation/selection (`{source:'selection', config:{universe:[{ticker}], signal:{kind:'indicator', indicatorId, params} | {kind:'trailing-return', lookbackMonths, skipMonths (>= 1; the ranking for a month only sees data through the previous month-end)}, topK, weighting, rebalance}, label}`), a strategy-over-node (`{source:'strategy-over', child:{ticker}, config:<BacktestConfig>, label}`), a saved strategy preset (`{source:'backtest-live', ticker, frequency, config, presetId, label}`), a curated public-library strategy (`{source:'backtest-public', strategyId, label}`), a published backtest share (`{source:'backtest-share', shareId, label}`), a gallery template (`{source:'portfolio-public', templateId, label}`), or a nested portfolio (`{source:'portfolio-mine', portfolioId, config, label}`). Strategies with a config get a node-level overfit check (a share carries only its frozen curve, so no overfit).

ticker.description: Yahoo Finance ticker, e.g. VTI, BND, GLD. Omit when `sleeve` is given.

factors.description: Factor ids to include. Default: MKT, SMB, HML, TERM, CREDIT (long history back to ~2001). All available: MKT, SMB, HML, MOM, QMJ, LOWVOL, TERM, CREDIT. The smart-beta trio (MOM, QMJ, LOWVOL) only has history from ~2011-2013, which shortens the analyzable window — factors without enough overlap are dropped and reported.

frequency.description: Return frequency for the regression of a `target` ticker. Monthly (default) is standard for factor analysis. Ignored for `template` / `strategy` (always monthly).

label.description: Optional display name for a custom `assets` portfolio. Default "Custom portfolio".

overlay.description: Optional portfolio-level trend-filter overlay applied to the WHOLE book: hold the entire portfolio only while its own level is above its N-month moving average, otherwise cash. Composition is monthly (a 10-month filter ≈ the classic 200-day one).

rebalance.description: Rebalancing cadence for custom portfolios (templates use their own).

strategy.description: Canonical rule-based strategy whose returns to decompose, e.g. dual-momentum-gem. One of: dual-momentum-gem, tsmom-sp500, faber-trend-timing, sector-momentum-rotation, risk-parity-inverse-vol, gtaa-aggressive, adaptive-asset-allocation. Precomputed; default factors.

target.description: Yahoo Finance ticker to decompose, e.g. AAPL, QQQ, TLT, ARKK. Omit when using `template` or `strategy`.

template.description: Built-in model portfolio whose returns to decompose, e.g. all-weather. One of: golden-butterfly, all-weather, permanent, dragon, faber-ivy, faber-gaa, bogleheads-3fund, wealthfront-classic, betterment-core, classic-60-40, classic-40-60, swensen, ferri-core-four, couch-potato, coffeehouse, no-brainer, larry, buffett-90-10, total-sp500. Precomputed; default factors.

name: decompose_factors
